title: Record the five-tier pricing ladder (ADR-1709) and file a row for every phase task
detail: PHASE 0 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. The decision record and the 26 rows of the ladder build, filed together so the board carries the whole plan. Closed in the same PR.
